purpose: Teach: 子連れ/いかんせん/寒気/絶句/思いこん/ほど遠い/年老い/顔立ち

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが子連れの家族を快く迎えられた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father welcomed families with children so kindly.
lines.style: Soft, almost to himself. Opening is gentle and distant. Long, thoughtful pauses between phrases. Watching something in memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、いかんせん戦中の苦労が大きかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — grandpa, the hardships during the war were so much for him to carry, weren't they, dear?
lines.style: Warm agreement that settles into something deeper. A slight rise on the opening. Tender but knowing. The diminutive 'dear' like she's speaking to him across decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが冬の寒気の中で働かれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father worked through the bitter cold winters.
lines.style: Quieter now. Each phrase deliberate, like he's turning over a detail he's held for years. Slight breath between thoughts. Weight in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の合格に絶句されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, he was absolutely speechless when our grandchild passed their exam, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: A lift of quiet pride and affection. Knowing him so well she can read his silence. Soft cadence. The 'dear' is intimate, familiar.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがご自分を不器用と思いこんでらした
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father always thought of himself as clumsy, unable.
lines.style: Slower pace, each word deliberate and sad. A slight catch, like he's defending the dead. Hollow at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、晩年も理想にはほど遠いと仰ってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, even in his later years he said he was still far from his own ideals, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, but tender underneath. A small sigh woven in. She's not correcting him — she's confirming she saw the same man.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんも年老いてこられたわ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father grew old alongside all of us.
lines.style: Very quiet, almost whispered. The finality of past tense. Pause before the last phrase. Like closing a door gently.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、品のある顔立ちでいらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, he had such a dignified face, didn't he, dear? Such grace in how he carried himself.
lines.style: Soft and close, almost as if she's speaking only to him now. A caress in the voice. Trailing into memory at the end.
